note: Shelf 2.0 demo, about 45 s. Copy to /tmp/shelf-shots/edit.json, then set each take's in/out and the zoom areas from its frames (render.py --sheet and --frame). 'area' is [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the take; the shelf is roughly the bottom 35% of the screen.

segments.title: Shelf 2.0
segments.subtitle: Everything you copy, ready to paste.

segments.note: Take 1: ⇧⌘V, the formatted notes are first, Return pastes them into TextEdit.
segments.caption: ⇧⌘V opens the shelf · Return pastes, formatting and all

segments.note: Take 2: select the JSON card, ⌘K, P (Format JSON): pretty JSON lands in TextEdit.
segments.caption: ⌘K · paste as plain text, Markdown, formatted JSON and more

segments.note: Take 3: type 'confirmation': only the receipt is left, found by the text inside it.
segments.caption: Search finds the text inside images

segments.note: Take 4: ⌘E on the receipt, arrow to $42.00, 'Due Friday', blur the email, Done, 25%, Return.
segments.caption: ⌘E · arrows, text, blur and crop, then paste

segments.note: Take 5: ⇧⌘2, drag over the receipt's text in TextEdit, 'Copied N words', ⌘V.
segments.caption: ⇧⌘2 · copy the text from anything on screen

segments.note: A freeze-frame from take 1 with the shelf open: zoom onto the 🔑 key card.
segments.caption: Keys and passwords are hidden, then deleted
